headline: SpaceX building $100 billion Starbase in Louisiana for thousands of Starship flights
summary: The massive 195-square-mile facility on Pecan Island will feature five launch complexes, each with two pads, and aims to support thousands of Starship missions annually.
details: SpaceX has announced plans for a new $100 billion "Starbase" launch site on the southern coast of Louisiana. Located on Pecan Island, the 195-square-mile facility will serve as a third potential location for launching its Starship rocket. Production is set to begin in 2027, with the first launch targeted for 2029.

Elon Musk stated the goal is to "make going to space as routine as flying on an airplane," enabling a future where humans explore among the stars. He emphasized that Starbase, Louisiana will be key to unlocking this future.

The facility will be massive, featuring five launch complexes, each equipped with two launch pads. It will also include a propellant production facility, power generation, vehicle processing, and residential housing for employees and their families.

This strategic location allows SpaceX to launch Starship rockets southward towards polar regions, ideal for placing its "Starmind" data center satellites into orbit. The site also offers close proximity to natural gas, crucial for producing Starship's methane-based rocket fuel.

SpaceX has pledged to work with Louisiana on extensive environmental restoration, including marshland and wildlife preservation, and storm protection. This commitment is part of the deal for the Pecan Island site, which was previously owned by Exxon Mobile.

headline: Bill Gates says we’ve passed AI’s danger thresholds. Now what?
summary: In a new interview, the billionaire philanthropist sounds an alarm on the urgency of getting our AI policies in order.
details: In a new interview, billionaire philanthropist Bill Gates stated that humanity has already crossed AI's danger thresholds. He emphasized the urgent need for robust AI policies to manage the technology's rapid advancement and societal impact.

Gates' comments highlight a growing concern among tech leaders and policymakers about the potential risks associated with unchecked AI development. The interview underscores the critical juncture we are at in shaping the future of artificial intelligence.
